name: Szuhakálló (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Szuhakálló: a blue shield with a patriarchal cross, a white and red checky pale and crossed hammers, with a grey leaf crest, above a scroll inscribed SZUHAKÁLLÓ.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Szuhakálló arms with crest and scroll
